name: metamodel.removeType
title: Remove type
summary: Remove a type that no element has, no type extends and no other definition names; only the metamodel files change, and no element.
details: The definition is removed from `types` of the file it is in, with its lines and the comment lines directly above it (SR-236 AK3, AK4). Its own properties that no other type has lose their definition, and so do the statuses it had that no other type has (a type without a status list has every status; the initial status always stays), as when the last type loses them (SR-238 AK5, SR-240 AK3; SR-237 AK5): one that an element of another type, or of a type the metamodel does not know, still holds stays, and `kept` names each with those elements; a kept relation property that has the type as target type refuses the removal, with its elements in `details.uses`: that entry counts every element that holds the key, of any type, and `metamodel.changeProperty` can take the type out of its `target-types`. No element file changes and nothing in Git (D-036); no element is deleted (D-045). Refused while an element of any status has the type (SR-236 AK7), a type extends it, or a relation kind names it in `source-types`, `target-types` or a limit, or a property in `target-types` (except a property that goes with it); the refusal names each of these and the use. Saved filters, perspectives and mapping files that name a removed key are listed in `mentions` and not changed (SR-236 AK7). Errors: input.invalid with details.reason unknown when no type has the key (details.type); input.invalid with details.reason in-use (details.named: the definitions that name the type; details.uses: kind, key, count and the short IDs of the first 20 elements in code-unit order); file.folder-missing when a repository of the workspace is not on this machine (details.repository, details.repositories); input.invalid with details.reason metamodel-invalid and the errors in details.problems when the metamodel would have an error; workspace.read-only when the metamodel files do not give a valid metamodel or the metamodel repository is not on this machine; input.invalid with details.reason git-folder when the metamodel folder is .git or a repository of its own (D-036); file.read-only when the metamodel repository cannot be written (SR-018 AK2); file.faulty when a removed definition or a node on the way to it is an alias or has an anchor (details.repository, details.file, details.line); file.changed-on-disk when another process changed a file since it was read (SR-236 AK10). Nothing is written on these.
whileReadOnlyReason: SR-236 AK5: a metamodel that cannot be read is never changed (SR-011 AK3).
